name: Stopwatch
description: Counts up from when it is shown; can be paused and resumed without losing the time, or restarted from a given offset.

params.name: label
params.help: Small line above the time (empty: none)

params.name: running
params.help: false pauses (the time is kept), true resumes

params.name: start_at
params.help: Start from this time (seconds or m:ss). Changing it restarts the stopwatch from that value
